Comment.value: Concerning Pipeweed strain (roadmap: concerning-pipeweed). Smoked at the water pipes of the Smoking Chamber; all effect comes from wg_bong.nss / pw_inc.nss, so it deliberately carries no item properties.

value.0:
A tight-packed pouch of the honest standby of the Southfarthing, grown in the Longbottom fields since old Tobold's day. The commonest good leaf in the Shire, and none the worse for it.

Smoked in a water pipe of the Smoking Chamber, the world comes sharply into focus and the books go quietly out of it.

Wisdom +4, Intelligence -2, Spot +5, Listen +5, for one hour of real time. Resting will not clear it.
